name: Premazepam
summary: Premazepam is a drug in the pyrrolodiazepine class. It is a partial agonist of benzodiazepine receptors and was shown in 1984 to possess both anxiolytic and sedative properties in humans but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Premazepam is a pyrrolodiazepine and acts as a partial agonist at benzodiazepine receptors. The mean time taken to reach peak plasma levels is 2 hours and the mean half life of premazepam in humans is 11.5 hours. About 90% of the drug is excreted in unchanged form. Of the remaining 10% of the drug none of the metabolites showed any pharmacological activity. Thus premazepam produces no active metabolites in humans.

uses.text: It is a partial agonist of benzodiazepine receptors and was shown in 1984 to possess both anxiolytic and sedative properties in humans but was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people, as it was never marketed. Drugs that act on benzodiazepine receptors can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, and regular use can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 由於從未上市，人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作用於苯二氮平受體的藥物可能引起嗜睡、協調變差和記憶問題，規律使用可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于从未上市，人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作用于苯二氮平受体的药物可能引起嗜睡、协调制差和记忆问题，规律使用可能导致依赖。

fact.en: In premazepam, the benzene ring of a typical benzodiazepine is replaced by a smaller pyrrole ring, which contains a nitrogen atom.
fact.zh: 在 premazepam 中，典型苯二氮平的苯環被換成一個較小、含氮原子的吡咯環。
fact.zhHans: 在 premazepam 中，典型苯二氮平的苯环被换成一个较小、含氮原子的吡咯环。
